newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street to open mixed, watching bonds and data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street to open mixed, watching bonds and data.

text.p: Wall Street shares are expected to open mixed and mostly unchanged on Monday, hoping bond yields stayed below seven percent and awaiting various economic data due out this week, analysts said.
"The stock market will be awaiting personal income and consumption data today, but bonds will call the tune," Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co, said.
On Friday, U.S. blue chips closed nearly unchanged after climbing back from a steep decline sparked by a profit warning from Intel Corp.
